title: drafting an id again replaces that id's own draft
source: intended: docs/decisions.md D7 and the drafts rows of the other decisions (a just-in-time build is a draft kept in .jitso/drafts/ and validated by code)
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-15, drafts; docs/decisions.md D7). A draft of an id that already has a draft replaces it: the file holds the second input's bytes and there is still one draft. Only a saved build blocks an id, never a draft.
